0001: """Isolated TU attempts and checked, locked publication of source and headers."""
0002: from contextlib import contextmanager
0003: import fcntl
0004: import hashlib
0005: import os
0006: from pathlib import Path
0007: import shutil
0008: import tempfile
0009: 
0010: import elfdb
0011: import toolchain
0012: 
0013: 
0014: @contextmanager
0015: def tree_lock(root=elfdb.ROOT, exclusive=False):
0016:     path = root / "build-decomp" / "publication.lock"
0017:     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0018:     with path.open("a+") as stream:
0019:         fcntl.flock(stream, fcntl.LOCK_EX if exclusive else fcntl.LOCK_SH)
0020:         try:
0021:             yield
0022:         finally:
0023:             fcntl.flock(stream, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
0024: 
0025: 
0026: def tree_state(root):
0027:     return {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
0028:             for base in (root / "decomp/src", root / "decomp/include")
0029:             for p in sorted(base.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()}
0030: 
0031: 
0032: class Stage:
0033:     def __init__(self, root=elfdb.ROOT):
0034:         self.root = root
0035:         work = root / "build-decomp" / "attempts"
0036:         work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0037:         self.path = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="tu-", dir=work))
0038:         with tree_lock(root):
0039:             self.baseline = tree_state(root)
0040:             shutil.copytree(root / "decomp", self.path / "decomp")
0041:         build = self.path / "build-decomp"
0042:         build.mkdir()
0043:         for name in ("include-gen", "drafts", "types.json", "examples.json"):
0044:             source = root / "build-decomp" / name
0045:             if source.is_dir():
0046:                 shutil.copytree(source, build / name)
0047:             elif source.exists():
0048:                 shutil.copy2(source, build / name)
0049:         for name in ("db", "scaffold"):
0050:             source = root / "build-decomp" / name
0051:             if source.exists():
0052:                 (build / name).symlink_to(source, target_is_directory=True)
0053: 
0054:     @contextmanager
0055:     def activate(self):
0056:         import autotest
0057:         import descriptors
0058:         import ghidra_cpp
0059:         import headers
0060:         import llm_loop
0061:         import promote
0062:         import properties
0063:         replacements = [(llm_loop, "ROOT", self.path), (headers, "ROOT", self.path),
0064:                         (ghidra_cpp, "ROOT", self.path), (ghidra_cpp, "_SRET", None), (ghidra_cpp, "_SRET_INPUT", None),
0065:                         (toolchain, "CC_CACHE", self.path / "build-decomp/cc-cache"),
0066:                         (headers, "INCLUDE", self.path / "decomp/include"),
0067:                         (headers, "OUT", self.path / "build-decomp/include-gen"),
0068:                         (headers, "DRAFTS", self.path / "build-decomp/drafts"),
0069:                         (headers, "TYPES", self.path / "build-decomp/types.json"),
0070:                         (promote, "INCLUDE", self.path / "decomp/include"),
0071:                         (promote, "GEN", self.path / "build-decomp/include-gen"),
0072:                         (autotest, "ROOT", self.path),
0073:                         (autotest, "TYPES", self.path / "build-decomp/types.json"),
0074:                         (autotest, "OUT", self.path / "build-decomp/hybrid/autotests")]
0075:         for module in (descriptors, properties):
0076:             replacements.extend([(module, "ROOT", self.path), (module, "INCLUDE", self.path / "decomp/include"),
0077:                                  (module, "SRC", self.path / "decomp/src")])
0078:         replacements.append((descriptors, "GEN", self.path / "build-decomp/include-gen"))
0079:         saved = [(module, name, getattr(module, name)) for module, name, _ in replacements]
0080:         environment = {k: os.environ.get(k) for k in ("OTL_INCLUDE_ROOT", "OTL_EXTRA_INCLUDE",
0081:                                                      "OTL_SELFTEST_TIMEOUT", "OTL_AUTOTEST")}
0082:         for module, name, value in replacements:
0083:             setattr(module, name, value)
0084:         os.environ["OTL_INCLUDE_ROOT"] = str(self.path)
0085:         try:
0086:             yield self
0087:         finally:
0088:             for module, name, value in saved:
0089:                 setattr(module, name, value)
0090:             for key, value in environment.items():
0091:                 if value is None:
0092:                     os.environ.pop(key, None)
0093:                 else:
0094:                     os.environ[key] = value
0095: 
0096:     def validate(self):
0097:         """Check every final TU and the complete headless suite before publishing."""
0098:         import hybrid
0099:         import objdiff
0100:         with self.activate():
0101:             os.environ.pop("OTL_EXTRA_INCLUDE", None)
0102:             original = objdiff.Original()
0103:             sources = sorted((self.path / "decomp/src").rglob("*.cpp"))
0104:             units = toolchain.parallel_map(lambda p: objdiff.compare_source(p, original, quiet=True), sources)
0105:             if any(unit.get("unknown") for unit in units):
0106:                 raise RuntimeError("final sources contain unknown original signatures")
0107:             count = len(list((self.path / "decomp/hybrid/tests").glob("*.cpp")))
0108:             shards = max(1, int(os.environ.get("OTL_SELFTEST_SHARDS", "0")) or min(4, toolchain.jobs()))
0109:             os.environ.setdefault("OTL_SELFTEST_TIMEOUT", str(120 + 20 * ((count + shards - 1) // shards)))
0110:             blob, loader = hybrid.build(out=self.path / "build-decomp/hybrid/final", src=self.path / "decomp/src",
0111:                                         tests=sorted((self.path / "decomp/hybrid/tests").glob("*.cpp")), verbose=False)
0112:             code, report = hybrid.selftest(blob, loader)
0113:             if code:
0114:                 raise RuntimeError("final headless selftest failed:\n" + "\n".join(report))
0115:         self.validated = tree_state(self.path)
0116: 
0117:     def publish(self):
0118:         if getattr(self, "validated", None) != tree_state(self.path):
0119:             raise RuntimeError("publication requires validation of the unchanged final tree")
0120:         final = tree_state(self.path)
0121:         changed = [name for name in sorted(set(final) | set(self.baseline))
0122:                    if final.get(name) != self.baseline.get(name)]
0123:         with tree_lock(self.root, exclusive=True):
0124:             if tree_state(self.root) != self.baseline:
0125:                 raise RuntimeError("source/header tree changed during the attempt; rebase and validate again")
0126:             originals = {name: (self.root / name).read_bytes() if (self.root / name).exists() else None
0127:                          for name in changed}
0128:             try:
0129:                 for name in changed:
0130:                     self._replace(name, (self.path / name).read_bytes() if name in final else None)
0131:             except BaseException:
0132:                 for name, data in originals.items():
0133:                     self._replace(name, data)
0134:                 raise
0135:         return changed
0136: 
0137:     def _replace(self, name, data):
0138:         target = self.root / name
0139:         if data is None:
0140:             target.unlink(missing_ok=True)
0141:             return
0142:         target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0143:         fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".publish-", dir=target.parent)
0144:         try:
0145:             with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
0146:                 stream.write(data)
0147:             os.chmod(temporary, target.stat().st_mode & 0o777 if target.exists() else 0o644)
0148:             os.replace(temporary, target)
0149:         finally:
0150:             Path(temporary).unlink(missing_ok=True)
